Hazard: Net DC charge delivered to electrodes

Hazard: Over-current delivery from a lifted electrode
Hazardous_Situation: Electrode partially lifts off skin mid-session raising local current density
Potential_Harm: Skin injury from concentrated current at reduced contact area

Mitigation_Code_Reference: CLAUDE.md §0.1 architectural rule; interlock_status.h has no assert-enable function by construction
Mitigation_Test_Reference: TRC-ILK-07 (no-bypass-surface test); design review (not a runtime test)

Hazardous_Situation: Core 0's sampling loop wedges but the core itself appears alive

Potential_Harm: Any of HAZ-01..04 reintroduced by an update
Mitigation_Code_Reference: firmware/bootloader/ab_rollback.c (self-test-gated confirm + automatic rollback); cloud/fleet-ota/rollout.js (staged rollout + halt-on-fault-spike)

Hazardous_Situation: Session data or device identity exposed via a compromised phone
